PASS: name/space collisions, AI reservation, empty and whitespace rejection, own-name edit, shared avatars, game start
PASS: cable profile entry waits for an opened lobby

notes: Settings and help accept local input before SIO is opened. Native scenario 5 spends 2400 frames in settings, then another 2400 frames in the open lobby before peers join.
Pending input captured during discovery is cleared when name editing begins. Guest START while waiting cannot confirm an empty name.
Long cable waits use native mGBA linked cores: standalone libretro does not complete an initiated serial transfer. No transport timeouts were changed.
Physical GBA and Pizza Boy were not available.
